title: Tide
extract: Tides are the rise and fall of sea levels caused by the combined effects of the gravitational forces exerted by the Moon and the Sun, and the rotation of the Earth. Tide tables can be used for any given locale to find the predicted times and amplitude. The predictions are influenced by many factors including the alignment of the Sun and Moon, the phase and amplitude of the tide, the amphidromic systems of the oceans, and the shape of the coastline and near-shore bathymetry. However, they are only predictions, and the actual time and height of the tide is affected by wind and atmospheric pressure.
